sents.en: Note: This repository contains Anthropic's implementation of skills for Claude.

paragraphs.en: Skills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads dynamically to improve performance on specialized tasks. Skills teach Claude how to complete specific tasks in a repeatable way, whether that's creating documents with your company's brand guidelines, analyzing data using your organization's specific workflows, or automating personal tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 技能是由指令、脚本和资源组成的文件夹，Claude 会动态加载它们，以提升在专门任务上的表现。 技能教会 Claude 以可重复的方式完成特定任务，无论是按照贵公司的品牌规范创建文档、使用贵组织的特定工作流分析数据，还是自动化个人任务。

paragraphs.en: This repository contains skills that demonstrate what's possible with Claude's skills system. These skills range from creative applications (art, music, design) to technical tasks (testing web apps, MCP server generation) to enterprise workflows (communications, branding, etc.).
paragraphs.zh: 本仓库包含了一些技能，用于展示 Claude 的技能系统能实现哪些功能。 这些技能涵盖创意应用（艺术、音乐、设计）、技术任务（测试网页应用、生成 MCP 服务器）以及企业工作流（沟通、品牌建设等）。

paragraphs.en: Each skill is self-contained in its own folder with a SKILL.md file containing the instructions and metadata that Claude uses. Browse through these skills to get inspiration for your own skills or to understand different patterns and approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 每个技能都自包含在自己的文件夹中，其中有一个 SKILL.md 文件，包含 Claude 所使用的指令和元数据。 浏览这些技能，可以为你自己的技能获取灵感，或了解不同的模式与方法。

paragraphs.en: Many skills in this repo are open source (Apache 2.0). We've also included the document creation & editing skills that power Claude's document capabilities under the hood in the skills/docx , skills/pdf , skills/pptx , and skills/xlsx subfolders. These are source-available, not open source, but we wanted to share these with developers as a reference for more complex skills that are actively used in a production AI application.
paragraphs.zh: 本仓库中的许多技能都是开源的（Apache 2.0 许可证）。 我们还包含了在底层驱动 Claude 文档功能的文档创建与编辑技能，位于 skills/docx、skills/pdf、skills/pptx 和 skills/xlsx 子文件夹中。 这些是源码可得但并非开源的技能，不过我们希望与开发者分享它们，作为更复杂技能的参考，这些技能在一个生产级 AI 应用中被积极使用。

paragraphs.en: These skills are provided for demonstration and educational purposes only. While some of these capabilities may be available in Claude, the implementations and behaviors you receive from Claude may differ from what is shown in these skills. These skills are meant to illustrate patterns and possibilities. Always test skills thoroughly in your own environment before relying on them for critical tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 这些技能仅用于演示和教育目的。 虽然 Claude 可能提供其中部分能力，但你从 Claude 获得的实现和行为可能与这些技能中展示的内容有所不同。 这些技能旨在说明各种模式和可能性。 在将技能用于关键任务之前，请务必在你自己的环境中对其进行充分测试。

paragraphs.en: You can register this repository as a Claude Code Plugin marketplace by running the following command in Claude Code:
paragraphs.zh: 你可以通过在 Claude Code 中运行以下命令，将此仓库注册为 Claude Code 插件市场（marketplace）：

paragraphs.en: /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills Then, to install a specific set of skills:
paragraphs.zh: /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills 然后，安装特定的技能集：

paragraphs.en: Alternatively, directly install either Plugin via:
paragraphs.zh: 或者，直接通过以下方式安装任一插件：

paragraphs.en: /plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills /plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills After installing the plugin, you can use the skill by just mentioning it. For instance, if you install the document-skills plugin from the marketplace, you can ask Claude Code to do something like: "Use the PDF skill to extract the form fields from path/to/some-file.pdf "
paragraphs.zh: /plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills /plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills 安装插件后，只需提及该技能即可使用它。 例如，如果你从市场安装 document-skills 插件，就可以让 Claude Code 执行类似这样的操作：“使用 PDF 技能从 path/to/some-file.pdf 中提取表单字段”

sents.zh: /plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills /plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills 安装插件后，只需提及该技能即可使用它。

paragraphs.en: Skills are simple to create - just a folder with a SKILL.md file containing YAML frontmatter and instructions. You can use the template-skill in this repository as a starting point:
paragraphs.zh: 技能（Skills）的创建非常简单——只需一个文件夹，其中包含一个带有 YAML 前置元数据和说明的 SKILL.md 文件。 你可以使用本仓库中的 template-skill 作为起点：

sents.en: Skills are simple to create - just a folder with a SKILL.md file containing YAML frontmatter and instructions.
sents.zh: 技能（Skills）的创建非常简单——只需一个文件夹，其中包含一个带有 YAML 前置元数据和说明的 SKILL.md 文件。

sents.en: You can use the template-skill in this repository as a starting point:
sents.zh: 你可以使用本仓库中的 template-skill 作为起点：

paragraphs.en: --- name : my-skill-name description : A clear description of what this skill does and when to use it --- # My Skill Name [ Add your instructions here that Claude will follow when this skill is active ] ## Examples - Example usage 1 - Example usage 2 ## Guidelines - Guideline 1 - Guideline 2 The frontmatter requires only two fields:
paragraphs.zh: --- name : my-skill-name description : 对此技能的功能及使用时机的清晰描述 --- # 我的技能名称 [ 在此添加当此技能激活时 Claude 将遵循的指令 ] ## 示例 - 示例用法 1 - 示例用法 2 ## 指南 - 指南 1 - 指南 2 frontmatter 仅需要两个字段：

paragraphs.en: The markdown content below contains the instructions, examples, and guidelines that Claude will follow. For more details, see How to create custom skills .
